how_to_apply: Attend the walk-in interview at the Administrative Building, NISER, Jatni, Dist- Khordha, Odisha- 752050 on the date for your post, between 10:00 A.M. and 11:00 A.M.
Bring Bio-data, recent passport size photograph, xerox copy of PAN Card and AADHAAR Card, original certificates and a set of attested copies of all certificates.
Internal candidates must submit an NOC from their current HOD/Principal Investigator.
Attend on 17 November 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM.
important_instructions: Contact person: Mr. Abhaya Kumar Mohanty, Administrative Officer, NISER (0674-2494015)

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Project Assistant, 1 Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years (as on 1 October 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.25,000 p.m. for Project Assistant, Rs.26,000 p.m. for Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Project Assistant: Graduation in Science with a Computer Course in Office Software. Staff Nurse: Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery OR B.Sc Nursing from a recognised University. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate should be able to speak the local languages (Odia & Tribal). Preference will be given to candidates residing in Khordha and Mayurbhanj district.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for a period of six months.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: District Khordha, Odisha (PBCR, Khordha - Project Assistant; EDP, Khordha - Staff Nurse).
